paragraphs: See the entry R' Elazar son of R' Yehudah of Bartota.[^1]

notes.text: Both heading titles are abbreviated. The target has abbreviated Elazar and בר״י, contextually read as son of R' Yehudah from the heading. The father title is unresolved; familiar Tannaitic identity does not supply it. Bartota remains only in the target.
